It teaches a strict operating model: prefer Airbnb-native endpoints before generic browser automation; treat send acknowledgments as attempted, not automatically confirmed; verify outbound messages in the live thread UI before declaring success; and never auto-resend from ambiguous or unconfirmed state. Designed to reduce duplicate messages, normalize agent behavior, and provide a safer foundation for Airbnb messaging, bookings, and calendar workflows — useful standalone today and as a companion to a more formal Airbnb adapter/tool layer tomorrow.
